statement.text:
(Well-known problem). Let G be a finite group, and V(ZG) the group of
normalized units of the integral group ring of G. Do the spectra of G and V(ZG)
coincide? That is, is it true that, for any integer n, there is an element of order n in
V(ZG) if and only if there is an element of order n in G?
    The answer is “yes” if G is solvable (M. Hertweck, Comm. Algebra 36 (2008),
3585–3588).                                                       A. Bächle, L. Margolis
